newsitem.title: RUSSIA: United Financial Group announces new Moscow staff.
newsitem.headline: United Financial Group announces new Moscow staff.

text.p: United Financial Group (UFG), a Moscow investment bank partly owned by Paribas, said on Friday it had appointed Tom Adshead head of Russian Equity Product.
Adshead, who will coordinate both sales and research at UFG, was formerly Russian telecoms analyst at CS First Boston in London.
UFG's former head of research Taco Sieburgh Sjoerdsma is leaving Paribas to join San Antonio Capital Management, a U.S. hedge fund.
UFG said Mikhail Surtsukov, previously head of securities at Russian oil group SIDANKO, would join as an oil analyst.
Jordy Doran, a salesman at Moscow investment bank CentreInvest Securities, is joining UFG's sales desk.
UFG is involved in equity brokerage, asset management, fixed income and corporate finance.
